description: Activation trigger-case dataset for ywc-toolkit-eval. Covers all 60 evaluated items (47 skills + 13 agents). Negatives are in-domain: prompts inside the development domain that no ywc-* item should claim. Every case carries a `source` recording where its PROMPT came from: `description-derived` cases were authored by reading the item's own description and therefore cannot fail the activation judge, which reads that same description — they do NOT count toward the >= 3-positive / >= 2-collision coverage floor. Only `session-trace` and `user-prompt` cases do. Session-trace prompts are verbatim user messages recovered from local session transcripts, with internal hostnames, absolute paths and credentials removed; typos and mixed-language phrasing are preserved because that is how the prompts actually arrive.
